python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json
p='store/jobs/j000018/out/pid.5372.dmp'
with open(p,'rb') as f: b=f.read(600000)
out=[]
# Obfuscated UTF16 candidate test: zero high bytes imply constant XOR of adjacent encoded bytes.
for start in range(100000,len(b)-40):
 seed=b[start+1]^b[start]
 if seed==0: continue
 n=0
 while start+2*n+1<len(b) and n<128:
  i=start+2*n
  if (b[i+1]^b[i])!=seed:break
  c=b[i]^(b[i-1] if n else (seed|0x43))^ (seed if n else 0)
  if not 32<=c<127:break
  n+=1
 if n>=8:
  text=''.join(chr(b[start+2*k]^(b[start+2*k-1] if k else (seed|0x43))^(seed if k else 0)) for k in range(n))
  out.append({'dump_offset':start,'seed':seed,'chars':n,'text':text})
json.dump(out,open(os.environ['OUT']+'/encoded-candidates.json','w'),indent=2)
print('candidates',len(out))
PY
